description.html: This 45x27x30 cm aquarium (36.5 L) offers enough room for a layout with live plants, roots and stone. The glass is precisely cut and bonded with aquarium silicone, which makes it fully watertight.

In this aquarium you can create a balanced ecosystem with a school of tetras, corydoras on the bottom and a couple of smaller gourami species. Live plants help with filtration and provide hiding places for smaller fish.

We build custom aquariums: any dimensions, glass thickness matched to the volume, optional openings for filters and heaters. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for a consultation and a price. Delivery to all cities in Serbia.
